webhook.title: Google Sheets webhook setup guide and simulator
webhook.subtitle: Connect Mesergo inbound SMS to Google Sheets, with support for multiple users and clients.

one.title: Create a new Google Sheet
one.description: Open <0>Google Sheets<1></1></0> and create a new spreadsheet where you want inbound SMS messages collected.

two.title: Open the Apps Script editor
two.description: In the top menu click <0>"Extensions"</0> ← <1>"Apps Script"</1>.

three.title: Paste and save the code
three.description: Delete all existing code in the editor, copy the code from here on the left and paste it in, then click the disk icon (<0>Ctrl+S</0> / <1>⌘+S</1>) to save.

four.title: Deploy the script
four.description: Click <0>"Deploy" ← "New deployment"</0>. <1></1>Choose type: <2>"Web app"</2>. <3></3>Set: <4></4>- <5>Execute as:</5> <6>"Me"</6> <7></7>- <8>Who has access:</8> <9>"Anyone" <10>*critical*</10></9>. Click Deploy and grant access to your account if Google asks.

five.title: Paste the deployment URL in Mesergo
five.description: Copy the URL you receive (called the <0>Web app URL</0>), then edit the routing settings for the required number in the system by pasting the link there — and you are done!

bulkAssign.title: Excel import — bulk line assignment
bulkAssign.description: Upload an Excel / CSV file with a list of line numbers (a column named "dest", "number" or "phone" — or simply the first column with no special header), choose the client all numbers should be assigned to, then click "Assign all numbers". New lines are created and activated automatically; existing lines only have their assignment updated — other settings (webhook, notes, etc.) are kept.
